caption_en: Accuracy and output continuity of LegSA-GINS and OiSAM-FGO. (a–d) Horizontal positioning and heading errors at the same evaluation point and matched times: 274 epochs during nominal walking and 54 epochs at the beginning of the antenna-obstruction trial. The error curves use OiSAM with a single initialization. (e) Available output over each complete trial for LegSA-GINS, OiSAM with a single initialization, and OiSAM reinitialized at recorded IMU gaps. Open circles on the reinitialized OiSAM row mark initialization-only states; line segments mark available dynamic output. Within each trial the rows follow the legend order. (f) Enlargement of the boxed interval in the antenna-obstruction trial; gray shading marks the first IMU input gap. Elapsed time is measured from the start of each evaluation window.
caption_zh: LegSA-GINS与OiSAM-FGO的精度及输出连续性。（a–d）在同一评价点与匹配时刻比较水平定位和航向误差：常规行走为274个历元，单侧天线遮挡记录起始阶段为54个历元；精度曲线采用仅初始化一次的OiSAM。（e）三条完整记录中，LegSA-GINS、仅初始化一次的OiSAM，以及在实测IMU缺口处分段重新初始化的OiSAM的输出时段。重新初始化的OiSAM行中，空心圆表示仅初始化的状态，线段表示有效动态输出；每个场景内三行按图例顺序排列。（f）放大单侧天线遮挡记录中方框标出的时段，灰带表示首次IMU输入缺口。时间均相对于各评价窗口起点。
meaning_zh: 上部比较相同时刻的精度，下部交代这些时刻覆盖了多少实际运行时间；右下放大首次输入缺口后的输出变化。

technical_notes.claim: Accuracy on shared support and continuity over the full trial must be read together.
technical_notes.position_point: POI_MIDPOINT; strict OiSAM and frozen V3, as already evaluated.
technical_notes.availability: All saved finite dynamic output, split at actual timestamp gaps; prior-only states are separate markers.
technical_notes.interval_plot_definition: Consecutive valid timestamps connected only within the archived cadence threshold (V3 0.1s; OiSAM 1.001s); no hold across a gap.

availability_zoom.selection: First recorded input gap, independent of error magnitude

technical_notes.panel_axis_scales: Within each scenario methods share axes; position and heading limits differ between scenarios and are explicitly ticked.
technical_notes.strict_vs_segmented: Segmented accuracy at GNSS1 is not mixed into the POI precision panels; it contributes full-trial availability only.
technical_notes.metrics_verification: COMMON_METRIC_VERIFICATION.csv matches all admitted existing RMSE values to <1e-12.

visual_review_notes: Final color and grayscale inspected. All matched points retained; prior-only outputs separated; true output gaps retained; initial obstruction-trial interval labelled explicitly. Availability bands use solid segments so line-style dashes cannot be mistaken for missing output.
